objective: Expose Hina's existing bounded, verified Minecraft inventory and nearby-entity snapshot in the owner Dashboard so the owner can inspect the live world and prefill a nearby X/Z target without granting any new game capability.
non_goals: Do not add Minecraft actions, collection, pathfinding, combat, mining, crafting, commands, LLM tool authority, or automatic movement.
Do not persist world, inventory, entity, chat, sign, book, NBT, plugin, or screenshot data.
Do not change the loopback control boundary, token handling, refresh cadence, emergency-stop behavior, model runtime, GPU allocation, or widget authority.
contracts: The Dashboard renders only the pre-existing bounded world snapshot returned through typed owner IPC; it opens no direct renderer network, Electron, Node, storage, or Mineflayer path.
Inventory and entity fields match the normalized runtime contract exactly; unavailable data remains visibly unavailable rather than fabricated.
An owner click may copy a displayed entity's bounded X/Z coordinates into the existing move-to form, but it cannot trigger movement or another side effect.
Entity names and labels remain untrusted game data, are rendered as escaped display text only, and are not sent to the text brain, memory, TTS, or a new action route.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue and workspace dependencies only; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: The Minecraft page shows bounded inventory entries and nearby entities from a real status object, with empty states for absent data.
Selecting an entity copies only its rounded X/Z values into the existing owner-controlled move-to form; the existing explicit movement button remains the sole movement trigger.
The renderer static-security checks prove no direct privileged or network API entered the page.
Desktop production tests, module-brief validation, GitNexus detect_changes, and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S7-live-world-inspector-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
